model.name: Qwen/Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B
model.moe_block: Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock: softmax(fp32) -> topk(4) -> norm_topk_prob=False -> cast BF16 -> expert loop 0..59 with index_add_ -> + sigmoid(shared_gate) * shared_expert

quantized.fake_quant: BF16 effective weights; everything else BF16 and unchanged

evaluation.forward: historical sequential 24-layer layer-wise offload forward (EP.layerwise_nll call order)

routing_recording.stored: ordered top-4 indices (int16, original slot order), top-4 probabilities, 5th probability (margin p4 - p5)
routing_recording.mechanism: forward hook on mlp.gate recomputing softmax+topk on the router logits; block forward unmodified
routing_recording.position_map: batch bi row r -> window bi*8 + r//512, position r%512

intervention.name: BF16-frozen top-k support
intervention.rule: selected_experts <- BF16 reference ordered indices (same window/position/layer) in every one of the 24 MoE layers; routing weights = CURRENT softmax probs gathered at the forced indices; no renormalisation (norm_topk_prob=False); logits not modified
intervention.implementation: moe_calib.frozen_routing.make_forced_forward (verbatim class forward with only selected_experts substituted), installed by moe_calib.inference_routing_override

parity_tests.A_record_only: BF16 and PARITY_CONFIG: recorder-attached forward vs historical EP.layerwise_nll: identical per-window NLL (bitwise), PPL; recorder vs no-recorder per-layer hidden-state hashes
parity_tests.B_bf16_self_routing: BF16 forced with its own recorded indices vs natural BF16: bitwise per-layer hidden states, final hidden states, per-window and per-token NLL
parity_tests.C_quant_self_routing: PARITY_CONFIG forced with its own natural indices vs its natural run: same recorded router selections/probs, bitwise per-layer and final hidden states, per-token NLL, PPL

primary_metric.definition: R_SD = SD_g(Delta_frozen_g) / SD_g(Delta_natural_g), sample SD (ddof=1) over the 5 orders, Delta_g = PPL(FC_O_g) - PPL(FR_O_g) (negative = FC lower PPL)
primary_metric.natural_values: from the new natural evaluator runs (required to reproduce the historical per-window NLL bitwise); historical SD 0.00287 is not hardcoded

decision_rules.ROUTING-INTERVENTION-BLOCKED: any mandatory parity / correctness check fails
decision_rules.ROUTING-NO-FLIPS: zero top-4 SET disagreements vs BF16 across all 10 primary configs and all 24 layers (natural routing) -> stop before frozen evaluation
decision_rules.note: practical screening criteria on 5 deterministic orders of one seed, not hypothesis tests

secondary: SD of FR and FC PPL under both regimes
mean / range / sign stability of Delta
fraction of windows improved/worsened by freezing
per-layer set and order-only disagreement, first divergence layer, per-window distribution
p4-p5 margin distributions (BF16 and quantized) for changed vs stable sets
token-level NLL concentration vs ORIGINAL (Analysis A), local and causal-prefix routing association (B, C), expert counts and forced-probability distributions
token_alignment: token NLL j (0..510) is the loss of predicting token j+1 from the logit at position j; the 'local' routing event of target j is at input position j (all 24 layers); its causal prefix is positions 0..j-1
early_stop: if all primary configs show zero top-4 set disagreement vs BF16 in all layers, stop (ROUTING-NO-FLIPS)
out_of_scope: no requantisation, no new orders/seeds, no router/shared-expert changes, no threshold tuning
